deviations.what: commit #1 (before the first population sample) holds every predictor value, all reading rules verbatim, the screen hash and the PRIMARY analysis code (analysis/common.py, c2a.py, tests); decomp.py and c2c.py were chained as addendum 1 before their arms were sampled, and c2b/geometry/novelty/c3b/run_all as addendum 2 before they were run

deviations.consequence: commitments.log keeps the order; corrections of committed files are new entries (supersede by path)
